_comment: Predefined biological modules for the endothelial glycocalyx non-resolution framework. Human symbols are authoritative; aliases are used for mouse ortholog mapping (case-insensitive match).

GCI.note: Synthesis/assembly of heparan-sulfate proteoglycans and hyaluronan; high score = structurally intact glycocalyx.

GDS.note: Sheddases and sulfatases that cleave HS/HYAL chains; high score = active shedding.

EIS.name_cn: 内皮身份/机械感知模块
EIS.note: Core endothelial identity and shear-responsive transcription; low score = loss of endothelial identity.

EAS.name_cn: 内皮激活/免疫募集模块
EAS.note: Leukocyte adhesion molecules and inflammatory chemokines; high score = activated, recruiting endothelium.

EIDS.note: Mesenchymal programme co-expressed with endothelial markers; high score = partial EndoMT.

MFS.name_cn: 促纤维化巨噬细胞模块
MFS.note: Monocyte-derived, scar-associated macrophage states; LY6C2 is the mouse-specific ortholog of human LY6C.

FNS.note: Myofibroblast and scar-associated matrix programme; high score = established fibrotic niche.

MRS.note: YAP/TAZ-TEAD mechanotransduction and focal-adhesion genes; CCN1/CCN2 = CYR61/CTGF.

EGNS.formula: EGNS = z(GDS) + z(EAS) + z(EIDS) - z(GCI) - z(EIS)
EGNS.note: Discovery/ranking metric only. It is a transcriptional STATE PROXY and must be calibrated against direct structural/shedding measurements (HS staining, lectin, EM).
